release: Operator, Claude chat 2026-11-03: test Redis p1210-index-test-redis / p1210-index-test-data on 127.0.0.1:6392, the isolated keyring service optimus-p1210-test, one artifact download, packages. Real Optimus keyring entries, optimus-redis and every other container were not touched.
release_departure: The release capped the test container at 1 GiB. Runs up to this report used Redis maxmemory 1 GiB, and ensure_memory_redis adds 512 MB of headroom, so the Docker limit was 1.5 GiB. Peak Redis use was 376.6 MB. Test and pilot settings now use maxmemory 512 MB, which makes the Docker limit 1 GiB. The pilot and the final test runs were repeated at that limit; the earlier runs are not evidence.

tests.dedicated_resource: tests/integration/context/test_memory_redis_lifecycle.py, on real Docker and Redis under the real ACL
tests.native_keyring: tests/integration/context/test_memory_native_keyring.py, Windows Credential Manager under the isolated service; no residue
tests.offline_model: tests/integration/context/test_memory_embedder.py, the real artifact through setup's layout and digest check, with every socket connection refused in the child

cases.case: the ACL file holds only a hash and the container's arguments no secret
without the password nothing is readable; the index user has no administrative command and no key outside oidx:
the password is only in the keyring; a rerun keeps it and downloads nothing
a wrong artifact or a keyring failure configures nothing
absent feature: no file means nothing is bound and today's context stays
the manifest binds the index literal both ways, and a manifest without an index keeps its version
ensuring again and concurrent launches agree on one resource
a stranger's container, a stranger on the port and a changed ACL are refused and left alone
a lookalike with the right name, label, image, port and volume but another memory limit, other server settings or no ACL mount is refused and left alone
--no-auto-start only checks, in serving and check-config; anything short of ready never stops a launch
no running Gateway is needed to ensure the container
a Redis outage refuses index requests, and what returns on the port proves itself again
an absent credential is a stable refusal from the index route
a borrowed Gateway's exit pauses the worker and its return resumes it, with no takeover or new port
a model request and an accepted capture batch both pass while the index is saturated; the batch goes through real durable capture, real delivery and the real route to a stand-in ledger
the configured artifact loads offline and its vectors separate related from unrelated text

unrun.reason: the released download went through fastembed; setup's own download runs when the operator first runs memory-setup, in Task 4's Zed proof

unrun.item: the product container in its final name and port
a capture batch committed to the real ledger under index saturation
unrun.reason: the ledger is Postgres and does not share the index's admission; the route, delivery and acknowledgement are real

decision_rejected: run-gateway does not ensure the container. It is an operator's manual Gateway; the ACP launch that needs the index ensures it, and the Gateway refuses with a stable code until then.
